title: Ordinance or Law Coverage of Regulated-Material Lines on Mold Remediation Jobs
content:
On a Mold Remediation job, the regulated-material lines are the job's asbestos sampling and lead-safe setup lines. Their total may be carried under the ordinance or law coverage of the Insurance Claim Services claim file the job is linked to.

**Rule.** On a claim file in approved status whose ordinance or law limit is at least their total, and that total is above 0.00, the amount carried under ordinance or law coverage is that whole total; on a claim file in approved status whose ordinance or law limit is above 0.00 but below that total, it is the ordinance or law limit; in every other case it is 0.00.

**Questions and answers**

*What is the regulated-material total?* The amounts of the job's asbestos sampling lines and lead-safe setup lines added together.

*The file is approved and its ordinance or law limit covers the whole total.* The whole regulated-material total is carried under ordinance or law coverage.

*The file is approved but its limit is smaller than the total.* The amount carried is the ordinance or law limit.

*The file is not approved, its limit is 0.00, the regulated-material total is 0.00, or there is no linked claim file.* Nothing is carried under ordinance or law coverage.

| Hypothetical approved file | Regulated-material total | Ordinance or law limit | Amount carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 612.40 | 2000.00 | 612.40 |
| B | 612.40 | 612.40 | 612.40 |
| C | 612.40 | 450.00 | 450.00 |
| D | 0.00 | 2000.00 | 0.00 |
